Spells:
Break Enchantment (Revolution5 Abju): R75' Successful caster level check (+15 maximum) against a DC of 11 + the effect's caster level, frees 20 targets in a 15' radius from enchantments, transmutations, and curses
Cure Critical Wounds (Resurrection4 Conj): Touched regains 4d8+20 hit points; undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will half)
Cure Light Wounds (Resurrection1 Conj): Touched regains 1d8+5 hit points; undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will half)
Cure Moderate Wounds (Resurrection2 Conj): Touched regains 2d8+10 hit points; undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will half)
Cure Serious Wounds (Resurrection3 Conj): Touched regains 3d8+15 hit points; undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will half)
Enthrall (Revolution2 Ench): R300' Captivates listeners (save Will negates) for concentration up to 1 hr plus 1d3 rd; attacking an enthralled creature ends the spell for all, and creatures who save can attempt a Charisma check to end it for others
Freedom (Revolution9 Abju): R75' Releases the target from movement restrictions (save Will negates)
Freedom Of Movement (Revolution4 Abju): Allows touched to ignore movement impediments, escape grapples, and move normally when underwater (save Will negates), for 200 min
Heal (Resurrection6 Conj): Touched regains 150 hit points and recovers from negative conditions; undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will negates)
Mass Cure Critical Wounds (Resurrection8 Conj): R75' 20 targets in a 15' radius regain 4d8+20 hit points; undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will half)
Mind Blank (Revolution8 Abju): R75' Target gains immunity to divination and scrying and +8 vs. mental effects (save Will negates) for 24 hr
Raise Dead (Resurrection5 Conj): Restores a willing soul, dead up to 20 days, to its touched corpse; the target regains 1 hit point per HD, gains 2 permanent negative levels (level 1 targets instead suffer 2 points of Constitution drain), and has a 50% chance of losing each prepared spell or unused spell slot
Refuge (Revolution7 Conj): Breaking a prepared object and speaking a command word transports the possessor to self home or transports self to possessor
Remove Curse (Revolution3 Abju): Allows a successful caster level check to dispel all curses from touched (save Will negates)
Remove Fear (Revolution1 Abju): R75' Suppresses fear in 6 targets in a 15' radius and gives them +4 vs. fear for 10 min (save Will negates)
Resurrection (Resurrection7 Conj): Fully restores a target willing soul, dead up to 200 years, using a piece of its corpse; the target gains a permanent negative level (level 1 targets instead suffer 2 points of Constitution drain)
Symbol Of Persuasion (Revolution6 Ench): Rune charms creatures in a 60' radius for 20 hrs (save Will negates) when triggered for 200 min
True Resurrection (Resurrection9 Conj): Restores life with full health, levels, and prepared spells to a willing chosen creature dead up to 200 years

Rebuke Death: Touch restores 1d4+10 hit points to a creature with negative hit points 5 times per day
